purpose: Preregistered evaluation of two opt-in warmup-time chain-rescue candidates (restart-from-best at slow-window boundaries; cross-chain metric/step pooling at boundaries) on the posteriordb models whose remaining gate failures are one bad chain out of four, plus the 10-D funnel, against the shipped defaults on the same fresh seeds.
harness: STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v5 protocol (4 chains, 1000/1000, Init::uniform(), v5 gates, arviz 0.23.4); src/main.rs adds the arm switch; funnel src/bin/funnel.rs with the arm switch

restart_constants.source: non-outlier chain with the largest step, ties by higher median log density
restart_constants.source_position: uniform over the source's window positions, drawn with the rescued chain's RNG

seeds_verified_unused: grep -w over the repository: matches are digit substrings inside numeric trace values only

funnel.gate: |z| <= 2 and omega bulk ESS >= 400 and omega rank R-hat <= 1.01

run_order: models in listed order; arms da, restart, pool; seeds ascending; strictly sequential; then the funnel cells arm by arm

decision_rule.statement: flip if a candidate passes >= 3 more of the 27 cells than da, no model seed-median ESS/gradient < 0.9x da, no |z| > 3.5 where da had none on the same seed, funnel |z| <= 2 on every seed

predictions.P1: restart fires on at most one chain per control cell and never after the second slow window there
predictions.P2: restart: funnel final steps within 10x across chains, funnel gate passed on every seed
predictions.P3: restart fires the density rule on any second-mode hmm_drive_0 chain by the third slow window and that cell passes R-hat
predictions.P4: no candidate moves any model's seed-median max |z| by more than 1
predictions.P5: pool within 0.9-1.2x da per gradient on every model, no gate gained
predictions.P6: the decision rule is not met by either candidate
